newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Expected better H1 results push up IBM.
newsitem.headline: Expected better H1 results push up IBM.

text.p: Shares in computer firm IBM South Africa Group Ltd rose more than four percent in early trade on Tuesday ahead of expected better interim results due later in the day, dealers said.
The share was last up 32 cents at 810 cents in a traded volume of 24,200 shares.
"IBM is already up and this is on its interims coming out later today. The guys are expecting them to be slightly better," one dealer said.
IBM is due to announce results for the six months ended June 30, later on Tuesday.
The share touched a day's high of 820 cents earlier and recently hit a new two-year low of 760 cents on August 15.
